Job Opening Overview

Make Your Own Perfume [MYOP] has listed a job opening for a Sales Executive in the Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad area, according to a recent professional platform posting. The role focuses on retail sales operations, customer engagement, and outlet merchandising within the region.

Role Responsibilities and Expectations

The position requires handling several daily retail and operational duties. According to the listing details, responsibilities include:

  • Working towards established monthly and daily targets.
  • Ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Developing and arranging promotional materials and in-store displays.
  • Ensuring adherence to store etiquette and schedules.
  • Assisting the store manager with stock management.
  • Completing all required trainings within defined timelines.
  • Engaging customers by inviting them to the outlet, introducing the MYOP concept, and guiding them in selecting the appropriate perfume.

Candidate Eligibility and Qualifications

The employer outlines specific preferences for applicants interested in the position:

  • Education: Preferably graduates.
  • Experience: Approximately two years of experience in retail sales with a business-to-consumer (B2C) brand.
  • Skills: Excellent communication skills, a strong work ethic, time management abilities, a passion for sales, and proficiency in multiple languages.

Practical Implications and Verification

For job seekers evaluating this opportunity, several details remain unverified or omitted in the public listing. Candidates should review the original posting directly to understand application procedures and platform requirements.
